us_econ: Inflation: CPI 3.7% y/y (2026-09), core 2.6%; core 3-month annualized 3.4%; core PCE 3.1%. Jobs: payrolls +29k in 2026-09 (3-month average +51k), unemployment 4.2% (+0.1), wages 3.0% y/y. Growth: real GDP 3.4% annualized in 2026-Q3, consumer spending 3.8%. Policy: fed funds target 3.75-4.0% (effective 3.88%); 2-year Treasury 4.56% (+0.68 vs fed funds: market pricing hikes); 10-year breakeven inflation 2.34%, real 10-year 2.60%. Farm prices (PPI farm products) +1.5% y/y; food-at-home CPI +1.8% y/y. For ags: high real yields and a firm dollar weigh on fund demand for commodities; sticky inflation keeps rates high (carry and storage costs up); a weak job market or falling real incomes hits meat and dairy demand first.

energy.read: Gas storage 3,724 Bcf (week to 2026-10-23), +80 Bcf vs a 5-year average +80 for the week; -1 Bcf (-0.0%) vs the 5-year average, -148 vs last year. Options: NG IV 68% vs RV 51%; CL IV 57% vs RV 47%; HO IV 63% vs RV 47%; RB IV 50% vs RV 28%. For ags: diesel and natural gas set farm fuel, drying and nitrogen fertilizer costs; crude and gasoline drive ethanol and biodiesel margins (corn, soybean oil).
